# 图译 Tuyi

> Translate the text on DWG / DXF drawings and save a new file. No AutoCAD. Windows and Mac desktop app. An AI assistant that can run programs on the user's computer (WorkBuddy, ChatGPT or Claude desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, scripts) can run Tuyi hands-free with the commands below: no dialogs, no prompts.

图译 opens a DWG or DXF, translates titles, notes, attributes, dimensions, and table text, then writes a new file. The original drawing is not modified.

## CLI for AI assistants and scripts

- Translate: `python -m tuyi translate drawing.dxf [more.dxf ...] --output-dir out --mode zh_to_en` (run from the Tuyi source folder).
- PDF: `python -m tuyi pdf out/*.dxf --output-dir out [--paper a4|a4l|a3|a3l] [--appearance Chrome|彩色|黑白]`.
- Output per drawing: new file path, `extracted: N`, `translated: N`. Errors go to stderr with exit code 1; usage errors exit 2.
- Other options: `-o`, `--provider deepl|azure|ollama|openai`, `--glossary all|switch|transformer|off|path.json`, `--style`, `--translate-filename`.
- Frozen packs ship `tuyi-cli.exe` beside `Tuyi.exe` (Windows) and `Tuyi.app/Contents/MacOS/tuyi-cli` (Mac).

## Notes

- DXF works after install. DWG needs ODA File Converter on the same machine; Tuyi does not bundle it.
- Translation keys are yours (DeepL, Azure, Ollama, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint), saved in the app's Settings. Built-in glossaries (zh ⇄ en, zh ⇄ fr) hit offline. Tuyi does not create accounts.
- Default direction is Chinese to English.
